Day 30 (old art) - April 2016 (age 13)

eyyyy we have made it to 30 days!

as a "special treat" (and totally not because this just happened to land on an art piece I digitalized) here's 2 drawings :D

Midori was a comfort character to me back then, she was easy to draw and cute

I never liked how she was portrayed in YanDev's videos, but as an autistic kid who couldn't read social cues super well I just latched on to the shared trait of being seen as "annoying" and drew her whenever I couldn't come up with a character to draw 

I still have a lot of love (and nostalgia) for her character, although I have no idea if she even still exists in the game

all I know is that the volunteers who created art and assets for YanDev deserved better ;3;
